frozen_policy_preservation.rule: Preserve the recorded v3/v4 GO or STOP decision verbatim; this policy classifies failure meaning and stage authorization, and never rewrites a frozen decision.

classes.ARTIFACT_INVALID: The artifact, provenance, census, schema, or recorded-decision binding is invalid.
classes.CORRECTNESS_FAIL: Deterministic reconstruction or exact numerical correctness failed.
classes.STATISTICALLY_INCONCLUSIVE: A stochastic diagnostic is uncalibrated, underpowered, or failed; this alone is not evidence of a code bug.
classes.RESOURCE_LIMIT: A runtime, memory, or inode constraint failed; this alone is not evidence of a code bug.

statistical_adequacy.reason: No stochastic threshold in P4-F v4 is mapped to an allowed downstream P5 or production observable error, and the 8192 prefix uses only four delete-one blocks.
statistical_adequacy.calibration_requirement: Use P5 exact/synthetic downstream sensitivity to set an allowed energy, variance, and observable error; then preregister simultaneous or hierarchical coverage and an adequate effective block count.

constraints: exact or synthetic coefficients when isolating P5 correctness
no claim that P4-F stochastic release adequacy passed
